spec.title: Running versions
spec.description: A version live at any point in a bucket fills it, so two rows overlap across an upgrade.

spec.expr: sum by (version) (max_over_time(gitea_build_info[$__interval]))

spec.title: Issues & PRs by repository
spec.description: Open and closed together. `New` is the net change; a deletion reads negative.

spec.expr: sum by (repository) (gitea_issues_by_repository)
round(sum by (repository) (delta(gitea_issues_by_repository[$__range])))

spec.title: Issues & PRs by label
spec.description: An item carrying several labels counts under each, so `Total` sums above the number of items.

spec.expr: sum by (label) (gitea_issues_by_label)
round(sum by (label) (delta(gitea_issues_by_label[$__range])))

spec.title: Memory
spec.description:
Peak per bucket: the lines follow the tops of the garbage collector's sawtooth.
- `next GC target` — the heap size at which the next collection starts.
- `resident memory` — the whole process: heap, stacks, mapped regions and allocator overhead.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.

spec.expr: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="prometheus.scrape.gitea"}[$__rate_interval])

spec.title: Mean GC pause
spec.description: Gaps are windows with no collection.

spec.expr:
rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_sum{job="prometheus.scrape.gitea"}[$__rate_interval])
/
rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_count{job="prometheus.scrape.gitea"}[$__rate_interval])

spec.title: Scrape duration
spec.description: Gitea answers a scrape by running one database COUNT per metric, so this tracks database responsiveness.

spec.expr: scrape_duration_seconds{job="prometheus.scrape.gitea"}

spec.title: Failed authentication
spec.description: SSH connections Gitea rejected, by source address; `Unknown keys` and `Rejected keys` have the keys.

spec.expr:
sum by (ip) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"}
  |= `Failed authentication attempt from`
  | pattern `<_>[W] Failed authentication attempt from <ip>:<_>`
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Rejected keys
spec.description: Keys that belong to an account without access to the requested repository, with the reason Gitea gave.

spec.expr:
sum by (user, key, reason) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"}
  |= `Failed authentication attempt for`
  | pattern `<_>[W] Failed authentication attempt for <user> with key <key> (<reason>) from <_>`
[$__range]))

spec.title: Unknown keys
spec.description: Keys registered to no account and no deploy key, with the address that offered each.

spec.expr:
sum by (fingerprint, ip) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"}
  |= `Unknown public key:`
  | pattern `<_>[W] Unknown public key: <fingerprint> from <ip>:<_>`
[$__range]))

spec.title: Git operations
spec.description:
Operations Gitea allowed, by transport. A fetch that finds nothing new counts the same as a full clone; `HTTP · Requests by client` shows where HTTPS operations come from.
- `fetch` — clone, pull, fetch, `ls-remote`.
- `lfs` — an LFS object exchange over SSH.

spec.expr:
sum by (verb) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `/api/internal/serv/command/`
  | pattern `<_>completed GET /api/internal/serv/command/<_>/<repo>?mode=<_>&verb=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>`
  | status="200"
  | label_format verb=`{{ if eq .verb "git-upload-pack" }}fetch{{ else if eq .verb "git-receive-pack" }}push{{ else if eq .verb "git-lfs-transfer" }}lfs{{ else if eq .verb "git-lfs-authenticate" }}lfs{{ else if eq .verb "git-upload-archive" }}archive{{ else }}{{ .verb }}{{ end }}`
[$__interval]))

sum by (verb) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |~ `info/refs\?service=git-`
  | pattern `<_>completed GET /<repo>/info/refs?service=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>`
  | label_format repo=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\.git$" .repo "" }}`
  | status="200"
  | label_format verb=`{{ if eq .verb "git-upload-pack" }}fetch{{ else if eq .verb "git-receive-pack" }}push{{ else if eq .verb "git-lfs-transfer" }}lfs{{ else if eq .verb "git-lfs-authenticate" }}lfs{{ else if eq .verb "git-upload-archive" }}archive{{ else }}{{ .verb }}{{ end }}`
[$__interval]))

spec.title: Git operations by repository
spec.description: Operations Gitea allowed.

spec.expr:
sum by (repo) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `/api/internal/serv/command/`
  | pattern `<_>completed GET /api/internal/serv/command/<_>/<repo>?mode=<_>&verb=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>`
  | status="200"
[$__range]))

sum by (repo) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |~ `info/refs\?service=git-`
  | pattern `<_>completed GET /<repo>/info/refs?service=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>`
  | label_format repo=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\.git$" .repo "" }}`
  | status="200"
[$__range]))

sum by (level) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} !~ `^\S+ - \S+ \[` !~ `HTTPRequest \[I\]`
  | regexp `^\S+ \S+ \S+ \[(?P<level>[A-Z])\] `
  | label_format level=`{{ if eq .level "I" }}info{{ else if eq .level "W" }}warn{{ else if eq .level "E" }}error{{ else if eq .level "F" }}fatal{{ else if eq .level "D" }}debug{{ else if eq .level "T" }}trace{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`
[$__interval]))

spec.description: With Errors only off, the router logs a line per HTTP request and dominates the stream. Gitea's database and cache are not included.

spec.expr:
{syslog_id="docker/gitea"} !~ `^\S+ - \S+ \[`
  | regexp `^\S+ \S+ (?P<caller>\S+) \[(?P<level>[A-Z])\] (?P<msg>.*)$`
  | level=~`$errors_only`
  | label_format level=`{{ if eq .level "I" }}info{{ else if eq .level "W" }}warn{{ else if eq .level "E" }}error{{ else if eq .level "F" }}fatal{{ else if eq .level "D" }}debug{{ else if eq .level "T" }}trace{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}`
  | label_format host=`{{ .hostname }}`
  | line_format `{{ .caller }} {{ .msg }}`
  | drop hostname, job, project, service_name, syslog_id, systemd_unit, transport, detected_level, caller, msg
time() - process_start_time_seconds{job="prometheus.scrape.gitea"}
sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <_> for <_>, <status> <_> in <dur> @ <_>` | status >= 500 [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Fetches
spec.description: Clones, pulls and fetches over both transports, as counted in `Git operations`.

spec.expr:
(sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `/api/internal/serv/command/` | pattern `<_>completed GET /api/internal/serv/command/<_>/<_>?mode=<_>&verb=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>` | status="200" | verb="git-upload-pack" [$__interval])) or vector(0))
+ (sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |~ `info/refs\?service=git-` | pattern `<_>completed GET /<_>/info/refs?service=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>` | status="200" | verb="git-upload-pack" [$__interval])) or vector(0))

spec.title: Pushes
spec.description: Over both transports, as counted in `Git operations`.

spec.expr:
(sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `/api/internal/serv/command/` | pattern `<_>completed GET /api/internal/serv/command/<_>/<_>?mode=<_>&verb=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>` | status="200" | verb="git-receive-pack" [$__interval])) or vector(0))
+ (sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |~ `info/refs\?service=git-` | pattern `<_>completed GET /<_>/info/refs?service=<verb> for <_>, <status> <_>` | status="200" | verb="git-receive-pack" [$__interval])) or vector(0))

spec.title: Failed auth
spec.description: SSH connections Gitea rejected; `Git` has the sources and keys.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `Failed authentication attempt from` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Issue & PR activity
spec.description: Net change per bucket; deletions read as negative.

spec.expr: round(delta(gitea_issues[$__interval]))
round(delta(gitea_issues_closed[$__interval]))

spec.title: Log errors
spec.description: Lines Gitea logged at error or fatal level; the `Logs` tab lists them.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} !~ `HTTPRequest \[I\]` | regexp `^\S+ \S+ \S+ \[(?P<level>[A-Z])\] ` | level=~`E|F` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Responses by status
spec.description:
Every request, health checks included.
- `304` — a client re-checking a file it already has; a poller fills the 3xx band.
- `401` — the challenge a Git or registry client receives before it sends credentials; a steady 4xx band is normal.

spec.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <_> for <_>, <status> <_> in <dur> @ <_>` | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Response time
spec.description: From the duration Gitea logs for each request, `304` answers included. A clone or a large download takes seconds, so p99 follows those.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <_> for <_>, <status> <_> in <dur> @ <_>` | unwrap duration(dur) | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.5, {syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <_> for <_>, <status> <_> in <dur> @ <_>` | unwrap duration(dur) | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

spec.description:
`Change` is the net change; a deletion reads negative. Each trend scales to its own row.
- `Comments` include system events — label changes, assignments, reviews.
- `Releases & tags` count a tag with no release, and drafts.
- `Access grants` are one row per user or team granted a repository.
- `SSH keys` include deploy keys.
- `Unactivated users` cannot sign in.

spec.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_repositories), "item", "Repositories", "", ""), "ord", "01", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_issues_open), "item", "Open issues & PRs", "", ""), "ord", "03", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_issues_closed), "item", "Closed issues & PRs", "", ""), "ord", "04", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_milestones), "item", "Milestones", "", ""), "ord", "05", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_comments), "item", "Comments", "", ""), "ord", "06", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_releases), "item", "Releases & tags", "", ""), "ord", "07", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_attachments), "item", "Attachments", "", ""), "ord", "08", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_users{state="active"}), "item", "Activated users", "", ""), "ord", "09", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_users{state="inactive"}), "item", "Unactivated users", "", ""), "ord", "10", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_organizations), "item", "Organizations", "", ""), "ord", "11", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_teams), "item", "Teams", "", ""), "ord", "12", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_accesses), "item", "Access grants", "", ""), "ord", "13", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_publickeys), "item", "SSH keys", "", ""), "ord", "14", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_watches), "item", "Watches", "", ""), "ord", "15", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_mirrors), "item", "Mirrors", "", ""), "ord", "16", "", "")
or label_replace(label_replace(sum(gitea_webhooks), "item", "Webhooks", "", ""), "ord", "17", "", "")

label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_repositories[$__range]))), "item", "Repositories", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_issues_open[$__range]))), "item", "Open issues & PRs", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_issues_closed[$__range]))), "item", "Closed issues & PRs", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_milestones[$__range]))), "item", "Milestones", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_comments[$__range]))), "item", "Comments", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_releases[$__range]))), "item", "Releases & tags", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_attachments[$__range]))), "item", "Attachments", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_users{state="active"}[$__range]))), "item", "Activated users", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_users{state="inactive"}[$__range]))), "item", "Unactivated users", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_organizations[$__range]))), "item", "Organizations", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_teams[$__range]))), "item", "Teams", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_accesses[$__range]))), "item", "Access grants", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_publickeys[$__range]))), "item", "SSH keys", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_watches[$__range]))), "item", "Watches", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_mirrors[$__range]))), "item", "Mirrors", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(round(delta(gitea_webhooks[$__range]))), "item", "Webhooks", "", "")

label_replace(sum(gitea_repositories), "item", "Repositories", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_issues_open), "item", "Open issues & PRs", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_issues_closed), "item", "Closed issues & PRs", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_milestones), "item", "Milestones", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_comments), "item", "Comments", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_releases), "item", "Releases & tags", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_attachments), "item", "Attachments", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_users{state="active"}), "item", "Activated users", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_users{state="inactive"}), "item", "Unactivated users", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_organizations), "item", "Organizations", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_teams), "item", "Teams", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_accesses), "item", "Access grants", "", "")
or label_replace(sum(gitea_publickeys), "item", "SSH keys", "", "")

spec.title: Requests by kind
spec.description:
`304 Not Modified`, health checks, metrics scrapes and the SSH server's internal calls excluded.
- `raw files` — a file served straight from a repository.
- `git` — Git over HTTPS, LFS included.
- `api` — the REST API.
- `actions` — Actions runners reporting on the jobs they run, and jobs uploading artifacts; what a job fetches counts under `git` and `api`.
- `registry` — the package and container registry.
- `web` — pages, avatars and assets.

spec.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <path> for <_>, <status> <_>` | status != "304" | label_format kind=`{{ if or (eq .path "/api/healthz") (eq .path "/metrics") }}probe{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/internal/" .path }}internal{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/api/actions/" .path) (hasPrefix "/twirp/" .path) }}actions{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/v2/" .path) (hasPrefix "/api/packages/" .path) }}registry{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/" .path }}api{{ else if or (contains "/info/refs" .path) (contains "/git-upload-pack" .path) (contains "/git-receive-pack" .path) (contains "/info/lfs/" .path) }}git{{ else if or (contains "/raw/" .path) (contains "/media/" .path) }}raw files{{ else }}web{{ end }}` | kind!~"probe|internal" [$__interval]))

spec.title: Requests by client
spec.description:
- `raw files` — a file served straight from a repository.
- `git` — Git over HTTPS, LFS included.
- `api` — the REST API.
- `actions` — Actions runners reporting on the jobs they run, and jobs uploading artifacts.
- `registry` — the package and container registry.
- `web` — pages, avatars and assets.

spec.expr: sum by (ip, kind) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <path> for <ip>:<_>` | label_format kind=`{{ if or (eq .path "/api/healthz") (eq .path "/metrics") }}probe{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/internal/" .path }}internal{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/api/actions/" .path) (hasPrefix "/twirp/" .path) }}actions{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/v2/" .path) (hasPrefix "/api/packages/" .path) }}registry{{ else if hasPrefix "/api/" .path }}api{{ else if or (contains "/info/refs" .path) (contains "/git-upload-pack" .path) (contains "/git-receive-pack" .path) (contains "/info/lfs/" .path) }}git{{ else if or (contains "/raw/" .path) (contains "/media/" .path) }}raw files{{ else }}web{{ end }}` | kind!~"probe|internal" [$__range]))

spec.title: Routes
spec.description: The Gitea handler that served the request. A route with a handful of requests reports its slowest one as p99. `http.Handler.ServeHTTP` is a handler Gitea mounts whole, the Actions runner API among them.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <_> for <_>, <_> in <dur> @ <h>` | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "-fm$" (regexReplaceAll "^\\(\\*?([^)]*)\\)" (regexReplaceAll "^[^(]*\\((.*)\\)$" .h "${1}") "${1}") "" }}` | unwrap duration(dur) | __error__="" [$__range]) by (route)

sum by (route) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed` | pattern `<_> completed <_> <_> for <_>, <_> in <_> @ <h>` | label_format route=`{{ regexReplaceAll "-fm$" (regexReplaceAll "^\\(\\*?([^)]*)\\)" (regexReplaceAll "^[^(]*\\((.*)\\)$" .h "${1}") "${1}") "" }}` [$__range]))

spec.title: Slow requests
spec.description: Requests that took longer than a second, by path.

spec.expr:
sum by (path) (count_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed`
  | pattern `<_> completed <_> <path> for <_>, <_> in <dur> @ <_>`
  | dur > 1s
  | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}`
[$__range]))

avg_over_time({syslog_id="docker/gitea"} |= `router: completed`
  | pattern `<_> completed <_> <path> for <_>, <_> in <dur> @ <_>`
  | dur > 1s
  | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}`
  | unwrap duration(dur) | __error__=""
[$__range]) by (path)

spec.name: errors_only
spec.label: Errors only
spec.description: Show only warnings and errors in the log.
